hardFailures: All six captures exceeded the 250,000-triangle ceiling at 321,705–322,809 triangles.
Simulation replay was exact, but the full camera replay hashes differed after reset.
S02–S05 merged or intersected the hero and Hollow; S04 drove contact through both bodies.
S05 lost the blade edge-on or behind the actors, and grip readability was not stable across S03–S06.
The focused blind gate rejected the candidate at 0/3, and the overall blind gate rejected it at 34/100 with 0/6 candidate wins.

primaryGap.prescription: Replace only the hero, Hollow, and weapon duel package with a matched high-fidelity PBR pair and one authored two-handed heavy strike plus synchronized HitReact; enforce visible grip constraints and non-intersecting contact spacing.
primaryGap.freeze: Leave environment, HUD, camera, controls, simulation, physics, seed, telemetry, and review contracts unchanged.
primaryGap.successCriterion: Fresh frozen S03, S04, and S05 must each show separated silhouettes, a fully visible blade with stable palm contact, a clear contact point, and grounded paired motion, then win 3/3 new blind comparisons.
